_about: Habit ladder for the morning check-in. Edit freely. ladder.py grows one thing per week while Matt is consistent and rolls back the moment he misses. 'level' indexes into 'levels'; level 0 is the never-miss floor. 'days' (Mon=0) limits a habit to those weekdays; 'when' marks one done later in the day (asked about the next morning).

gate._about: habit_gate.py: after 'after' on the habit's days, Matt's first Claude prompt gets today's logic practice page; 👍/done records the dose, skip records 0.

watch._about: missed.py: if the check-in hasn't started, re-send its links 'resend_after_min' after the crossword text ('crossword_at', his crossword profile's hour) so his iPhone Shortcut opens the check-in, not the crossword (never after 'resend_until'); Matt's first Claude prompt before 'nudge_until' gets a one-line nudge.
